svg.title: IBM Storage Ceph in three of IBM’s figures
svg.desc: Up to 3.3 PB of physical capacity in one 2U IBM Fusion Storage Node CS1. From 2 to 300 CS1 systems in one cluster, from 211 TB to 1 exabyte of raw capacity. Up to 6:1 compression in IBM FlashCore Module drives, for highly compressible data.
